scene: You step off the glass-bottomed boat onto Lighthouse Reef's slippery rocks.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along rocky reef ground. On far left, the moored glass-bottomed boat floats beside a glowing tide pool. Left of centre, the boy stands facing right. Centre, a fat seal reclines on a boulder. Far right stands a tall striped lighthouse with a closed red door at its base.
shown: a glowing blue tide pool resting on the rocks at the far left
a spotted grey seal lounging on a flat boulder at the centre
a red arched wooden door at the base of the lighthouse on the right
